practice.description: One practice: its date, the clock time it starts, the team and what it is for. Its notes after practice are doc.body.

block.description: One drill in a practice, in running order. doc.title names it and doc.body holds its coaching points, copied from the library when it is added.

drill.description: A drill in the coach's library: its usual length, its kind and its equipment. doc.title names it and doc.body says how it runs.
